newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain Valencia sells 3-,5-yr bonds at lower yields.
newsitem.headline: Spain Valencia sells 3-,5-yr bonds at lower yields.

text.p: Spain's Valencia regional government (Generalitat de Valencia) said on Tuesday it allotted a total of 3.15 billion pesetas in three- and five-year bonds at a public auction.
Yields fell sharply versus the previous auction on September 24. Results are as follow:
ISSUE Yield Pvs Price Pvs Bid Allocated
NOTE - * In both cases new tranches of old issues were offered.
Moody's long-term debt rating for Generalitat de Valencia is Aa3. At the end of June 1996 the region's total debt was 441 billion pesetas of which 192 billion pesetas is in bonds.
